note: _mulier in silentio discat –_ let the woman learn in silence (Douay Version). The noun _silentium_ here “is not silence, but privacy. St. Paul did not wish women to be ignorant; he ordered (…) that they should be instructed privately,” George C. Richards: _A Concise Dictionary to the Vulgate New Testament_. London 1934 (xvi, 130 pp.), p. 112.
